---
title: "AI Class Notes"
---

We record each class
and post its transcript and notes on this site.
In the course repository,
they're in the `sessions/` folder,
with one folder per class named by its date.

AI models write the notes from the transcript and the slides,
so they can get things wrong.
Check anything important against the slides.
We ran the same prompt through more than one model,
so you can compare their notes with each other
and with the notes Plaud, the recording app, makes on its own.
To see how the notes are made,
or to suggest a change to the prompt,
read [How the notes are made](README-prompt.md).
